DML.SELECT: SELECT plan_order_condition_id as "id", plan_id as "planId", plan_order_id as "planOrderId", element_type_id as "elementTypeId", element_id as "elementId", param_type_id as "paramTypeId", element_type_param_id as "elementTypeParamId", threshold_operation_id as "thresholdOperationId", threshold_val1 as "thresholdVal1", threshold_val2 as "thresholdVal2", element_type_state_id as "elementTypeStateId", plan_order_condition_order as "planOrderConditionOrder", nexus_and as "nexusAnd", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.plan_order_conditions WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.plan_order_conditions (plan_order_condition_id, plan_id, plan_order_id, element_type_id, element_id, param_type_id, element_type_param_id, threshold_operation_id, threshold_val1, threshold_val2, element_type_state_id, plan_order_condition_order, nexus_and, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:id=getNextId{'conf.plan_order_conditions'$'plan_order_condition_id'$'plan_id=planId;plan_order_id=planOrderId'}, :planId, :planOrderId, :elementTypeId, :elementId, :paramTypeId, :elementTypeParamId, :thresholdOperationId, :thresholdVal1, :thresholdVal2, :elementTypeStateId, :planOrderConditionOrder, :nexusAnd, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE conf.plan_order_conditions SET element_type_id = :elementTypeId, element_id = :elementId, param_type_id = :paramTypeId, element_type_param_id = :elementTypeParamId, threshold_operation_id = :thresholdOperationId, threshold_val1 = :thresholdVal1, threshold_val2 = :thresholdVal2, element_type_state_id = :elementTypeStateId, plan_order_condition_order = :planOrderConditionOrder, nexus_and = :nexusAnd, enabled = :enabled, visible = :visible, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE plan_order_condition_id = :id AND plan_id = :planId AND plan_order_id = :planOrderId
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM conf.plan_order_conditions WHERE plan_order_condition_id = :id AND plan_id = :planId AND plan_order_id = :planOrderId
